name: Permanent Residence Permit (Law No. 200/2010)

requirements.blocker_text: 5 years of prior continuous temporary residence in Moldova.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of continuous temporary residence.

requirements.blocker_text: 3 years of prior continuous temporary residence, if married to a Moldovan citizen throughout that period.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 years of continuous temporary residence while married to a Moldovan citizen.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 (or 3) years' continuous temporary residence

sources.title: Bureau for Migration and Asylum (legacy igm.gov.md domain) -- immigration overview: permanent residence after 5 years of continuous temporary residence (3 years if married to a Moldovan citizen)

Direct access to legis.md (the authoritative legislation portal) failed in this build (returns only a JS loading placeholder), so the exact statute article could not be independently confirmed. Given Moldova's citizenship law was JUST fully replaced in 2025 (Law No. 253/2025 superseding Law No. 1024/2000 -- see md_citizenship_naturalisation.json), there is a live-legal-transition risk that adjacent statutes like Law 200/2010 could also have been touched by recent reform; erring toward draft until the precise article is confirmed rather than treating a paraphrased overview as sufficient for published status on a route this central.
